related_questions.snippet: There are currently no rules in NSW which require you to self-isolate if you test positive to COVID-19, but it is strongly recommended you stay home until your symptoms have gone and take steps to protect others. related_questions.question: Is the COVID pandemic still going on?
related_questions.snippet: The WHO ended the PHEIC for COVID-19 on 5 May 2023. The disease has continued to circulate. However, as of 2024, experts were uncertain as to whether it was still a pandemic. Pandemics and their ends are not well-defined, and whether or not one has ended differs according to the definition used.

related_questions.question: Are people still getting long COVID now?
related_questions.snippet: Approximately 6 in every 100 people who have COVID-19 develop post COVID-19 condition. While data are limited, the chance of developing post COVID-19 condition appears to be lower now than earlier in the pandemic. However, the virus is still circulating widely, and every new infection is associated with a risk.
